description: Get an app's revenue AVERAGES from maintained ledgers (point-reads, no scan): ARPU (avg MRR per paying customer) and average lifetime value per paying customer. Lifetime value = combinedLifetimeValueCents (all customers' LTV: active-subscription annualized run-rate + banked one-offs) — it RECONCILES to the dashboard's per-customer LTV and is NOT the same as recognisedCashToDateCents (actual cash banked), which is returned separately. Answers 'average lifetime value per user' and 'what's my ARPU'. Averages are ACROSS THE PAYING BASE — NOT any one customer's pay (use get_customer for one). 'user' = paying customer here; a per-all-users average is not_instrumented. `not_instrumented` when no revenue rail is connected — not $0.

project.description: The app to read, as a project id from list_projects (e.g. 'proj_3a8f137bccdd4f'). With a workspace key (cd_wk_) this is required unless you've set a default via use_project; with a single-app key it is ignored.

name: get_revenue_averages
title: Get ARPU and average lifetime value
